rubrics.justification: It correctly notes an expanded blastocyst with thinning zona, but overinterprets the image by asserting significant cytoplasmic vacuolization/granularity and gives limited reliable detail on ICM/TE, which are not clearly delineated here.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior biochemical pregnancy, sperm parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality reasonably well, though some links are speculative.

The structure is logical and the probability estimate is explained, but several deductions rely on weakly supported assumptions from the image and prior biochemical pregnancy is somewhat overinterpreted.

While general counseling and proceeding with transfer are reasonable, recommendations such as ERA, NK-cell testing, thrombophilia screening after a single biochemical pregnancy, aspirin, and routine PGT-A in a 32-year-old are not well aligned with standard evidence-based IVF guidelines.
It provides clear next-step suggestions for transfer and future planning, but some proposed investigations/interventions are not appropriately selective for this case.
